summary: Sets or clears a single bit in the byte at this+110 (this+0x6E), selected by bit index a2, controlled by boolean a3. When a3 is nonzero the bit is set (OR); when a3 is zero the bit is cleared (AND NOT). Returns the bit mask value, which is the inverted mask after the clear branch.

operations.description: v4 = 1 << a2; build a single-bit mask from bit index a2.
v5 = this[110]; read the current byte value at this+0x6E.
Branch on a3: nonzero selects the set path, zero selects the clear path.
Set path: this[110] = v4 | v5; OR the mask into the byte at this+0x6E.
Clear path: invert the mask (LOBYTE(v4) = ~(_BYTE)v4) then this[110] = v4 & v5; AND the inverted mask into the byte at this+0x6E.
Return v4; the mask value, which is the inverted mask after the clear path.
